p: to Isaiah the prophet the son: To hear some new prophecy and to have comfort from him.
the birth: The dangers are so great, that we can neither avenge this blasphemy, or help ourselves any more than a woman in labour.
remnant that are left: Meaning, for Jerusalem which only remained of all the cities of Judah.
upon him: The Lord can with one blast blow away all the strength of man, and turn it into dust.
he heard say of Tirhakah king: That is, Sennacherib.
Behold: For the kings of Ethiopia and Egypt joined together against the king of Assyria because of his oppression of other countries.
God in whom thou trustest deceive: The closer the wicked are to their destruction, the more they blaspheme.
LORD: Before the Ark of the covenant.
prayed before the LORD: He shows what the true refuge and help is in all dangers, that is, to flee to the Lord by earnest prayer.
bow down thine ear: Show by effect that you will not allow your Name to be blasphemed.
living God: By this title he discerns God from all idols and false gods.
kingdoms of the earth may know: He shows the reason the faithful desire God to deliver them: that is, that he may be glorified by their deliverance.
virgin the daughter of Zion hath: Because as yet Jerusalem had not been taken by the enemy therefore he calls her virgin.
against the Holy One of Israel: God counts that as an injury done to him, and will avenge what is done to any of his saints.
lodgings of his borders: Meaning Jerusalem, which Isaiah calls the height of his borders, that is, of Judah, Isa 37:24.
now have I brought it to: He declares that as he is the author and beginning of his Church, he will never allow it to be completely destroyed, as other cities and kingdoms.
inhabitants were of small power: Thus he describes the wicked, who flourish for a time, and later fade and decay like flowers.
hook in thy nose: I will bridle your rage, and turn you to and fro as it pleases me.
sign unto thee: God not only promised him the victory, but gives him a sign to confirm his faith.
root downward: The Lord will multiply in great number that small remnant of Judah that escaped.
zeal of the LORD of hosts: The love, that God has for his Church will overcome the counsels and enterprises of men.

smote him with the sword: This was the just judgment of God for his blasphemy, that he would be slain before the idol that he preferred to the living God, and by those who should by nature have needed his defence.
